SELECT driver_job.id, driver_job.driver_id, driver_job.task_transport_id, driver_job.start_org_id, driver_job.end_org_id, driver_job.status, driver_job.start_handover, driver_job.finish_handover, driver_job.plan_departure_time, driver_job.actual_departure_time, driver_job.plan_arrival_time, driver_job.actual_arrival_time, driver_job.create_time FROM work_driver_job driver_job
LEFT JOIN sys_user auth_user ON driver_job.driver_id = auth_user.id
LEFT JOIN work_task_transport task_transport ON driver_job.task_transport_id = task_transport.id
AND driver_job.deleted = 0
AND driver_job.status = #{params.status}
AND driver_job.id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{params.id},'%')
AND auth_user.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{params.driverName},'%')
AND task_transport.id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{params.taskTransportId},'%')
order by driver_job.create_time desc

SELECT task_transport.id, task_transport.trips_id, task_transport.start_org_id, task_transport.end_org_id, task_transport.status, task_transport.assigned_status, task_transport.loading_status, task_transport.truck_id, task_transport.pickup_picture, task_transport.cargo_picture, task_transport.certificate_picture, task_transport.deliver_picture, task_transport.pickup_longitude, task_transport.pickup_latitude, task_transport.deliver_longitude, task_transport.deliver_latitude, task_transport.plan_departure_time, task_transport.actual_departure_time, task_transport.plan_arrival_time, task_transport.actual_arrival_time, task_transport.plan_pick_up_time, task_transport.actual_pick_up_time, task_transport.plan_delivery_time, task_transport.actual_delivery_time, task_transport.create_time FROM work_task_transport task_transport
LEFT JOIN work_driver_job driver_job ON task_transport.id = driver_job.task_transport_id LEFT JOIN sys_user auth_user ON driver_job.driver_id = auth_user.id
AND task_transport.deleted = 0
AND task_transport.id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{params.id},'%')
AND auth_user.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{params.driverName},'%')
AND task_transport.status = #{params.status}
order by task_transport.create_time desc
SELECT CAST(status AS CHAR) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM work_task_transport GROUP BY status
SELECT CAST(status AS CHAR) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM work_transport_order GROUP BY status
SELECT CAST(scheduling_status AS CHAR) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM work_transport_order WHERE scheduling_status IS NOT NULL GROUP BY scheduling_status
